About Razorpay
Razorpay is India's leading payment solutions company, enabling businesses of all sizes to accept, process, and disburse payments. We're on a mission to revolutionize money management for businesses.

Role: Frontend Engineer (2-4 years)

We are looking for a passionate Frontend Engineer to join our Checkout team. You will own the end-to-end experience of millions of transactions that happen every day on Razorpay's checkout flow — one of the most performance-critical UIs in Indian fintech.

What You'll Do
- Build and maintain high-performance React components for Razorpay's payment checkout SDK used by 8M+ businesses
- Own the performance budget for checkout — our target is sub-2-second load on 2G networks
- Collaborate with design and product to ship A/B tested features that directly impact payment conversion rates
- Write comprehensive unit and integration tests; maintain >85% code coverage
- Debug cross-browser and cross-device issues including edge cases on low-end Android devices
- Review code for peers and contribute to frontend architecture decisions

What We're Looking For
- 2-4 years of production experience with React and modern JavaScript (ES2020+)
- Strong TypeScript skills — you think in types, not just use them
- Deep understanding of browser rendering, repaints, and performance profiling
- Experience with CSS-in-JS, CSS Modules, or similar styling approaches
- Comfortable with REST APIs, async patterns, error handling
- Familiarity with Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and code review practices
- Strong sense of product ownership — you care about what you ship, not just that you ship

Bonus Points
- Experience with payment flows, PCI-DSS environments, or fintech products
- Next.js, SSR/SSG experience
- Webpack or Vite configuration experience
- You've built something that millions of people use

About Google
Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. The Web Platforms team builds the tools and frameworks that power Google's consumer products used by billions.

Role: Senior Frontend Software Engineer

You will work on Google's core web platform, building UI systems and frameworks that are used across Search, Maps, YouTube, and other flagship products. The decisions you make will affect the web experience of over 4 billion users.

What You'll Do
- Design and build large-scale frontend systems with a focus on reliability, performance, and developer experience
- Lead technical design discussions and write design documents for complex features
- Define best practices and mentor junior engineers across the team
- Partner with product managers and UX designers to translate product vision into technical reality
- Conduct thorough code reviews and raise the engineering bar across the team
- Contribute to open-source projects and internal developer tools

What We're Looking For
- 5+ years of frontend engineering experience with deep JavaScript/TypeScript expertise
- Experience building large, complex web applications with a major framework (React, Angular, Vue)
- Strong foundations in computer science: algorithms, data structures, system design
- Demonstrated experience with web performance optimization at scale
- Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG) and building inclusive UIs
- Track record of technical leadership — mentoring, design docs, raising standards
- BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points
- Experience contributing to open-source JavaScript frameworks
- Knowledge of browser internals, rendering pipelines, V8 engine
- Experience with WebAssembly or other emerging web platform APIs

About Zepto
Zepto is India's fastest growing quick-commerce startup, delivering groceries in 10 minutes. We're building the infrastructure for instant commerce across India.

Role: Frontend Engineer (0-2 years)

We're looking for hungry engineers who want to build at breakneck speed. As a Frontend Engineer at Zepto, you'll work on the consumer app and web experience that over 5 million customers use every week.

What You'll Do
- Build responsive React components for Zepto's web app and internal ops tools
- Implement pixel-perfect UIs from Figma designs with cross-browser compatibility
- Integrate with backend APIs for product listings, cart, checkout, and order tracking
- Optimize app performance for mid-range Android users — our core demographic
- Ship features fast, measure them, and iterate based on data
- Participate in on-call rotations for production issues

What We're Looking For
- 0-2 years experience with React.js and modern JavaScript
- Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design
- Comfort with REST API integration and async JavaScript
- Experience with version control (Git) and basic CI/CD
- Fast learner who thrives in ambiguity and ships without hand-holding
- Genuine ownership mentality — you don't just close tickets, you care about the outcome

Bonus Points
- React Native experience (we're building our own app)
- Experience with e-commerce or consumer apps
- TypeScript experience
- You've shipped something to production that users actually use

About Swiggy
Swiggy is India's leading on-demand convenience delivery platform, serving 500+ cities and processing millions of orders daily. Our backend systems power real-time order routing, dynamic pricing, and fleet management at massive scale.

Role: Backend Engineer — Platform (2-5 years)

The Platform team at Swiggy builds the core infrastructure that every product team depends on: order management, real-time location tracking, notification systems, and payment processing. You will work on systems that handle peak loads of 100K+ requests per second.

What You'll Do
- Design and build high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go or Java
- Architect microservices with clear ownership boundaries and clean APIs
- Build event-driven systems using Kafka for real-time order state management
- Optimize database schemas and queries for PostgreSQL at scale; use Redis for caching layers
- Conduct performance profiling and eliminate bottlenecks before they hit production
- Write runbooks, define SLOs, and participate in on-call rotations
- Review architecture proposals and elevate team engineering standards

What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years backend experience with Go, Java, or Python in production
- Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and API design
- Strong SQL skills and database design experience (PostgreSQL preferred)
- Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven patterns
- Understanding of distributed systems: consistency, availability, partition tolerance
- Experience with Redis or similar in-memory caching systems
- Strong debugging and performance profiling skills

Bonus Points
- Experience operating services on Kubernetes at scale
- Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger)
- Experience with geo-spatial data or real-time location systems
- You've been on-call for a high-traffic production service

About Amazon
Amazon is guided by four principles: customer obsession, passion for invention, commitment to operational excellence, and long-term thinking. We are driven by the excitement of building technologies and inventing new solutions.

Role: Senior Software Development Engineer — Supply Chain

You will join Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization team, building systems that determine how billions of dollars of inventory flows through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Your code will directly impact product availability and delivery speeds for hundreds of millions of customers.

What You'll Do
- Lead the design and implementation of distributed services processing millions of events per day
- Write high-quality, well-tested code in Java or Python, and review others' code rigorously
- Drive technical design discussions from ideation to production deployment
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, reliability gaps, and architectural tech debt
- Mentor junior engineers and help them grow into senior roles
- Collaborate with product and science teams to translate ML model outputs into production systems
- Own your services end-to-end: design, build, deploy, monitor, and on-call

What We're Looking For
- 5+ years of software engineering experience in a production environment
- Deep understanding of distributed systems, CAP theorem, and failure modes
- Strong software design skills: ability to write design documents and lead design reviews
- Proficiency in Java or Python with strong OOP and functional programming skills
- Experience with AWS services: EC2, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, Lambda
- Strong algorithms and data structures fundamentals
- Demonstrated ability to mentor others and raise team engineering standards

Bonus Points
- Experience with supply chain, inventory, or fulfillment domain
- ML pipeline integration experience
- Infrastructure-as-code experience (CDK, CloudFormation)

About Groww
Groww is India's largest investment platform with over 10 million active investors. We're making investing simple, transparent, and accessible for every Indian. Our mission is to help Indians achieve financial freedom through smart investing.

Role: Backend Engineer — Investments Platform (2-4 years)

You will work on the core investments infrastructure — order management, portfolio tracking, NAV computation, and regulatory reporting. This is a high-stakes, compliance-first environment where correctness is non-negotiable.

What You'll Do
- Build and maintain backend services for mutual fund orders, stock trading, and SIP management
- Integrate with BSE/NSE APIs, RTA systems, and payment gateways
- Implement rigorous data validation and reconciliation pipelines
- Build SEBI-compliant reporting systems and audit trails
- Optimize high-throughput order processing pipelines for market hours peak loads
- Work closely with compliance team to implement regulatory changes
- Design and maintain PostgreSQL schemas for financial data with strict consistency requirements

What We're Looking For
- 2-4 years backend experience with Python (Django/FastAPI) or Java (Spring Boot)
- Strong PostgreSQL skills with understanding of ACID transactions
- Experience building APIs consumed by mobile apps at scale
- Comfort with async task processing (Celery, RabbitMQ)
- Security-first mindset — experience with data encryption, audit logs, access control
- Ability to write clean, well-tested code with >80% coverage
- Understanding of financial products (mutual funds, stocks, ETFs) is a plus

Bonus Points
- Prior experience in fintech, banking, or investment platforms
- Knowledge of SEBI regulations, AMFI guidelines
- Experience with BSE StAR MF or NSE APIs
- CFA or finance background

About CRED
CRED is a members-only platform that rewards creditworthy individuals. We obsess over craft, design, and creating experiences that feel magical. If you think most apps are mediocre and you want to build something genuinely beautiful, CRED is for you.

Role: Full Stack Engineer (2-4 years)

At CRED, full-stack means full ownership. You'll own features from database schema to pixel-level UI, working on products that our discerning, high-intent member base actually notices and appreciates. We ship with intention — not just speed.

What You'll Do
- Build end-to-end features across React frontend and Node.js backend
- Design database schemas and write efficient PostgreSQL queries
- Build and maintain GraphQL/REST APIs consumed by web and mobile clients
- Work closely with designers to implement experiences with pixel-perfect fidelity
- Write comprehensive tests and maintain high code quality standards
- Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and design system components
- Monitor your services in production — you own what you ship

What We're Looking For
- 2-4 years building production full-stack applications
- Strong React skills with TypeScript — you think in components and state
- Proficient Node.js backend development with Express or similar
- Good SQL skills with PostgreSQL; understanding of indexing and query optimization
- High design sensibility — you notice bad kerning, you care about micro-interactions
- Strong communication skills — can articulate trade-offs and decisions
- Genuine ownership mindset

Bonus Points
- GraphQL API design experience
- React Native experience
- AWS experience (EC2, RDS, S3)
- Experience building financial products

About PhonePe
PhonePe is India's leading digital payments platform with 500M+ registered users. We process billions of transactions and our ML systems sit at the heart of fraud prevention, credit scoring, and merchant intelligence.

Role: ML Engineer — Risk & Fraud (2-4 years)

You will build and deploy machine learning models that protect hundreds of millions of users and merchants from fraud. Your models run in real-time, making decisions in under 100ms on every transaction.

What You'll Do
- Build, train, and deploy fraud detection models using gradient boosting, neural networks, and anomaly detection techniques
- Design feature pipelines processing real-time transaction streams and historical behavioral data
- Own model performance monitoring — detect drift, retrain, A/B test improvements
- Collaborate with data scientists to productionize research models
- Build ML infrastructure using MLflow, Feature Store, and model serving layers
- Analyze false positives/negatives and tune thresholds to balance friction vs. security
- Write production Python services that serve model predictions at 50K+ TPS

What We're Looking For
- 2-4 years ML engineering experience — not just notebooks, but deployed production models
- Strong Python skills with PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Solid ML fundamentals: classification, regression, ensemble methods, evaluation metrics
- Experience with feature engineering at scale (real-time and batch features)
- SQL proficiency for data exploration and model validation
- Experience with ML lifecycle tools (MLflow, DVC, or similar)
- Understanding of precision-recall tradeoffs in imbalanced classification

Bonus Points
- Prior fraud detection or risk modeling experience
- Experience with graph neural networks for fraud rings
- Real-time ML serving experience (sub-100ms latency)
- Spark or Flink for large-scale feature computation

About Atlassian
Atlassian creates software that empowers every team. With tools like Jira, Confluence, and Bitbucket, we serve 10M+ users globally. Our platform engineering team ensures every product team ships fast with confidence.

Role: Site Reliability Engineer (3-5 years)

You will join our Platform SRE team, embedding with product teams to build reliability into their services from the ground up — not bolt it on after. You'll own infrastructure, incident response, and the internal developer platform.

What You'll Do
- Design and maintain Kubernetes clusters hosting 200+ microservices across AWS
- Build and improve CI/CD pipelines that process 1000+ deployments per day
- Define and track SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets with product teams
- Lead incident response: detection, mitigation, root cause analysis, and post-mortems
- Build self-service infrastructure tooling so engineers can ship without bottlenecks
- Write infrastructure-as-code with Terraform and Helm charts
- Mentor developers on reliability best practices and production readiness reviews

What We're Looking For
- 3-5 years in SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering roles
- Deep Kubernetes experience — you know pod scheduling, resource limits, RBAC
- Strong AWS (or GCP/Azure) experience with IaC via Terraform
- Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD)
- Python or Go scripting for automation and tooling
- Observability expertise: metrics, logs, traces (Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger)
- Strong incident management skills and post-mortem culture

Bonus Points
- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
- Experience with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
- Security hardening experience in cloud environments
- Experience with chaos engineering (Chaos Monkey, Litmus)

About Meesho
Meesho is India's fastest growing e-commerce company, empowering 150M+ small businesses and individual entrepreneurs across Tier 2-4 India. Our Android app is the primary commerce tool for millions of resellers who rely on it to run their livelihoods.

Role: Android Engineer (2-5 years)

You will work on Meesho's core Android app used by 150M+ users, many of whom are first-time smartphone users in rural and semi-urban India. Performance on low-end devices, low-bandwidth reliability, and simplicity of UX are paramount.

What You'll Do
- Build new features in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose for Meesho's seller and buyer apps
- Optimize app performance: startup time, memory usage, battery consumption on low-end devices
- Implement offline-first architecture for low-connectivity environments
- Build and maintain A/B testing infrastructure for feature experiments
- Analyze crash reports, ANRs, and performance metrics via Firebase
- Mentor junior Android developers and conduct code reviews
- Work with product and design to ship experiments and measure outcomes

What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years of Android development with Kotlin
- Proficiency with Jetpack Compose and modern Android architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture)
- Strong understanding of Android lifecycle, threading, and performance
- Experience with Coroutines, Flow, and reactive programming
- REST API integration experience with Retrofit/OkHttp
- Familiarity with dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger)
- Genuine empathy for low-end device users and Bharat-market constraints

Bonus Points
- Experience building for users on 2G networks and 2GB RAM devices
- Knowledge of ProGuard/R8 and APK size optimization
- Experience with deep links, push notifications, and Firebase ecosystem
- Understanding of accessibility for first-time smartphone users

About Microsoft
Microsoft enables digital transformation for the era of an intelligent cloud and an intelligent edge. Security is Microsoft's top priority — we invest $1B+ annually in security and employ thousands of security professionals globally.

Role: Senior Security Engineer — Azure Platform

You will join Microsoft's Azure Security team, responsible for the security posture of Azure's core platform services used by millions of enterprises. You will drive threat modeling, security reviews, and incident response for services at global scale.

What You'll Do
- Lead threat modeling sessions for new Azure platform features and APIs
- Conduct security design reviews and penetration tests on internal services
- Build and maintain automated security testing pipelines (SAST, DAST, fuzzing)
- Define security standards and guardrails for hundreds of engineering teams
- Respond to security incidents, conduct root cause analysis, and drive remediation
- Work with external security researchers through Microsoft's bug bounty program
- Develop security training materials and raise security culture across the org

What We're Looking For
- 5+ years in application security, cloud security, or security engineering
- Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10, threat modeling methodologies (STRIDE)
- Experience with cloud security: IAM, network security groups, encryption at rest/transit
- Proficiency in Python or C# for security tooling automation
- Experience with SAST tools (Semgrep, CodeQL) and DAST tools (Burp Suite)
- Strong cryptography fundamentals: TLS, PKI, key management
- Ability to communicate security risks to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points
- Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or OSCP certification
- Experience with Zero Trust architecture
- Azure Security certifications
- Open-source security tool contributions

About Flipkart
Flipkart is India's homegrown e-commerce leader, serving 400M+ registered customers across 27,000+ pincodes. Our data infrastructure processes 10TB+ of event data daily and powers decisions from pricing to logistics.

Role: Data Engineer — Commerce Intelligence (2-5 years)

You will build the data pipelines and infrastructure that power Flipkart's analytics, personalization, and business intelligence. Your pipelines will process millions of customer events per hour and feed the models that determine what 400M users see on their homepage.

What You'll Do
- Design and build batch and streaming data pipelines using Spark and Kafka
- Maintain and optimize Airflow DAGs for data orchestration
- Build dimensional models and data marts for commerce analytics use cases
- Ensure data quality, lineage, and SLA adherence for downstream consumers
- Collaborate with data scientists to productionize feature pipelines
- Optimize Hive/Presto queries for large-scale data processing efficiency
- Design schemas for new data sources and document data contracts

What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years data engineering experience with Python as primary language
- Strong Apache Spark experience — you know RDDs, DataFrames, Spark tuning
- Kafka experience for real-time event streaming pipelines
- Airflow for workflow orchestration and monitoring
- Strong SQL and data modeling skills (star schema, dimensional modeling)
- Experience with Hive, Presto, or similar distributed query engines
- Data quality mindset — you build pipelines that fail loudly, not silently

Bonus Points
- dbt experience for transformation layer
- Delta Lake or Apache Iceberg for ACID table formats
- Experience with real-time feature stores
- Flink for stateful stream processing

About Navi
Navi is building the future of financial services — insurance, lending, and now Web3 financial primitives. Our blockchain team is exploring how DeFi can make credit and insurance more accessible for Indians.

Role: Blockchain Engineer (2-4 years)

You will build the smart contract infrastructure and DeFi protocol integrations that power Navi's Web3 financial products. You'll work on novel financial primitives in a regulated environment — a rare combination.

What You'll Do
- Write, test, and audit Solidity smart contracts for lending and insurance protocols
- Integrate with DeFi protocols (Aave, Compound, Uniswap) for yield and liquidity
- Build frontend integrations using Ethers.js and wallet connectors (MetaMask, WalletConnect)
- Design token economics and on-chain governance mechanisms
- Write comprehensive smart contract tests with 100% coverage requirement
- Conduct internal security audits and coordinate with external auditors
- Monitor on-chain activity and build alerting for anomalous behavior

What We're Looking For
- 2-4 years building production smart contracts on EVM chains
- Deep Solidity proficiency — you know common attack vectors (reentrancy, flash loans, oracle manipulation)
- Experience with Hardhat or Foundry development environments
- Strong JavaScript/TypeScript for off-chain integrations
- Understanding of DeFi primitives: AMMs, lending protocols, yield farming
- Security-first mindset — every contract is a target
- Gas optimization skills — cost matters at scale

Bonus Points
- Experience on Layer 2 networks (Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism)
- TheGraph subgraph development
- Rust/Anchor for Solana development
- Prior involvement in DeFi protocol governance
